verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents interruptible instances as one of three priority-tiered instance types. They are priced through a bidding system, are 'often 50%+ cheaper than on-demand', and are described as 'Low Priority… may be paused', which states the basic preemption behavior (pause, not destroy) and its bid-priority basis. missing for 10: detailed preemption semantics (notice period, how outbidding triggers pauses, resume and data-persistence behavior, billing while paused), independent or hands-on corroboration of interruptible behavior and discounts.
